title: Privacy Policy | BettaFish.website
description: Privacy practices for BettaFish.website, including the current email contact channel and static prepublication website.
intro: This policy describes the static prepublication build and its current email contact channel. It must be updated before analytics, advertising, forms or other services are enabled.

sections.heading: Current foundation build
paragraphs: The foundation site does not contain a contact form, user account, advertising script or analytics tracker.
The hosting provider may process ordinary technical request information needed to deliver and protect the site. Its practices are governed by its own applicable terms and policies.

sections.heading: Email contact
paragraphs: If you email bettafish.website@gmail.com, the mailbox provider and BettaFish.website receive the email address, message content and any information you choose to include. That information is used to respond, investigate corrections or handle the request.
Do not send sensitive personal, financial or medical information. Email records should be retained only as long as reasonably needed for the request, legal obligations or abuse prevention.

sections.heading: Future services
paragraphs: Analytics, advertising, affiliate tracking, embeds, newsletters or forms will not be added silently. The external-script inventory and this policy must be updated before those services are approved.
Any consent mechanism must reflect the data actually collected rather than displaying a generic cookie banner.

sections.heading: Prepublication policy
sections.text: The policy must be reviewed again if any analytics, advertising, form, embed or newsletter service is introduced.
